title: Cam gesture action catalog — what Cam does when a hand signal resolves
notes: Every gesture in gestures.json binds to exactly one action id here (per context).

target = where the effect lands. companion_pwa = the on-device Safari PWA (companions/web); converse_server = scripts/cam-converse-server.py; device_bridge = cross-device session bus over Tailscale; mesh = nulltickets namespaces; vision = PaddleDetection/Pupil hotspots.
sentinel_class mirrors config/connectome/sentinel-policy.json classes. Gesture actions never reach egress/spend/self_modify — those stay voice/CLI + Aaron.
aaron_identity_required = true means switch.identity must be act (Aaron face/voice match) before the action fires; otherwise the gesture is logged to mesh/gestures and held.
confirm = second signal needed before firing (thumb_up, voice 'yes', or on-screen tap). Reversible low-risk UI actions do not confirm.

categories.ui: Layout of the page Cam is showing (collapse / expand / scroll / zoom / select)
categories.device: Move Cam's live session or a payload from one of Aaron's devices to another (iPhone ↔ iPad ↔ Mac)
categories.converse: Control the live conversation turn (attention, stop, yes/no, repeat, volume)
categories.memory: Write or retract mesh memory from the moment
categories.vision: Ask Cam to look at something

actions.title: Collapse the page
actions.effect: Collapse the current page / panel / card stack to its compact state (accordion closed, transcript folded, portrait small).

actions.title: Expand the page
actions.effect: Expand the current page / panel / card stack to its full state (accordion open, transcript unfolded, portrait large).

actions.title: Scroll up
actions.effect: Scroll the focused surface up by one viewport step; in a media view, raise volume one step.

actions.title: Scroll down
actions.effect: Scroll the focused surface down by one viewport step; in a media view, lower volume one step.

actions.title: Zoom in
actions.effect: Increase zoom / text scale of the focused surface one step.

actions.title: Zoom out
actions.effect: Decrease zoom / text scale of the focused surface one step.

actions.title: Select / air tap
actions.effect: Activate the focused element (button, card, option) — the air equivalent of a tap.
actions.notes: Only fires on elements marked gesture-selectable; never on outbound/submit controls (those need voice + Sentinel).

actions.title: Grabshot — capture the current screen
actions.effect: Capture the current companion view as an image into vault/00-Inbox/attachments and reference it in mesh/gestures.

actions.title: Toggle camera preview
actions.effect: Show / hide the local camera preview tile in the PWA.

actions.title: Previous page / panel
actions.effect: Move to the previous page, tab, or gallery item.

actions.title: Next page / panel
actions.effect: Move to the next page, tab, or gallery item.

actions.title: Go home
actions.effect: Return to the Cam home view (portrait + converse).

actions.title: Choose numbered option
actions.effect: When Cam has offered a numbered choice, pick option N (1–5) by finger count.
actions.notes: Only valid in context 'choice'. Choices that lead to egress/spend still route through Sentinel.

actions.title: Grab payload for handoff
actions.effect: Begin a cross-device carry: freeze the current session snapshot (page, transcript position, media ref, or grabshot) as a carry payload on the converse server with a TTL.
actions.huawei_equivalent: AI Air Transfer step 1 — open palm at ~half arm, pause, clench fist to grab

actions.title: Release payload on this device
actions.effect: Finish a cross-device carry: the device whose camera sees the fist open claims the carry payload and resumes the session there (iPhone → iPad, iPad → Mac, …).
actions.huawei_equivalent: AI Air Transfer step 2 — hold fist in front of receiving screen, pause, open palm to send

actions.title: Cancel handoff
actions.effect: Drop the carry payload; the session stays on the origin device.

actions.title: Follow me to this device
actions.effect: Pull Cam's active session to the device that saw the beckon, without a prior grab (the 'come here' shortcut).

actions.title: Cam, look at me
actions.effect: Engage: open a listening turn, face the camera that saw the wave, show the engaged glyph.

actions.title: Stop / interrupt
actions.effect: Cut the current speak turn and any in-flight UI animation; keep the session.

actions.title: Yes / confirm
actions.effect: Answer the pending low-risk prompt with yes. Never counts as a Sentinel approval — egress/spend/self_modify still need Aaron via cam-sentinel.py.

actions.title: No / dismiss
actions.effect: Answer the pending prompt with no, or dismiss the current suggestion card.

actions.title: Say that again
actions.effect: Replay the last Cam turn (text + speak if presence allows).

actions.title: Louder
actions.effect: Raise Cam's speak volume one step.

actions.title: Quieter
actions.effect: Lower Cam's speak volume one step; at the floor, mute speak for this session.

actions.title: Mute / unmute Cam's voice
actions.effect: Toggle Cam's audible speak for this session; text and portrait stay live.

actions.title: Thanks, Cam
actions.effect: Positive reinforcement on the last turn: mark it helpful in mesh/prefs so the pattern is favored later.

actions.title: Pause / resume presence
actions.effect: Toggle Cam's face + voice presence between live and still-portrait-text-only (does not flip switch.kill).
actions.huawei_equivalent: Air press — palm moves from 30–40 cm to ~5 cm to answer a call or pause/resume playback

actions.title: Hold everything (soft)
actions.effect: Put every motor into session hold and show the hold banner. Soft: does not flip switch.kill (Aaron-only CLI). Resume by voice or the same gesture.

actions.title: Remember this moment
actions.effect: Distill the current context (last turns, visible page, device, time) into mesh/facts + MemoryBear with tag gesture:remember.

actions.title: Never mind — forget that
actions.effect: Retract the most recent gesture-originated mesh write if it is inside the grace window (60 s); otherwise ask.

actions.title: Undo last UI action
actions.effect: Undo the most recent reversible gesture action on this device.

actions.title: What is that?
actions.effect: Run one detection pass (PaddleDetection / Pupil world frame) on the region the finger points at and answer in the converse turn.
actions.notes: Side effect motor.pupil / PaddleDetection stays under switch.pupil_vision; one frame, no continuous tracking.

actions.title: Engage gesture mode
actions.effect: Show the engaged glyph at the top of the screen (Huawei-style) so Aaron knows the next motion will be read; starts the gesture window.
actions.huawei_equivalent: Hand icon appears at top of screen once palm is held 20–40 cm away

actions.title: Log only
actions.effect: No effect on any surface. The recognized gesture is written to mesh/gestures for later teaching. Used when switch.gesture_control is hold, identity is missing, or the gesture is unbound in this context.
